rationale: Provisional face-specific upper-lid bands from the source-only preflight. These bands are inputs for parent review, not approval of a gaze or eyelid design. Inspect the selected 3x3 gaze atlas at native scale. Keep iris and sclera movement readable; do not freeze too much eyelid area. Reduce or move bands if they cover gaze pixels needed for clear direction. Do not extend across full eye boxes or neutral-center iris.
